justification: The castle has many staircases, and this week one of them simply was not there — Jayden Daniels has no game to play, so there was nothing to decide, only a door to walk through instead of a wall. Goff steps in, as he did the reverse errand for Daniels not long ago; a man does not sulk at an empty staircase, he takes the one that is present. Everyone else stays precisely where they have earned their place: Taylor and Wilson carry the ground game, Pickens and Olave and Garrett Wilson the air, Warren plays through his Questionable tag because a tag is not yet a verdict, and the kicker and the defense are left undisturbed, as settled things ought to be. The garden does not need tending every week — only when a staircase moves, and only then.
